coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: TSO Liang-yü 左良玉 (T. 崑山), 1598–1645, Apr. 29, Ming general, was a native of Lin-ch'ing, Shantung. Devoid of formal education, he was a versatile bowman and able strategist. His first post in Liaotung, in 1628, ended disastrously but his second under Hou Hsün (see under Hou Fang-yü) in Ch'ang-p'ing, Chihli, started him on his career.
